pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

comment.comment:
The part 2 of Phase III is now live: checkout + webhooks

• Checkout: get paid inside your app or agent
  one api call with your telemoney key
  your customer pays in telegram from their wallet
  bot, mini app or telemoney.org/pay

• Webhooks: your server is told when it's paid
  checkout.paid, signed with hmac-sha256
  retried for about a day if you're down
  you allow the url with a tap in the bot

• AI Agents: create_checkout over mcp
  agents can charge for their work, no human needed

• Docs, curl examples and code to check signatures
  telemoney.org/agents

0.5% fee, same as every payment link

With the completion of this roadmap, we will be moving onto checking which features matter, and which ones to write-off.

TeleMoney now covers every possible aspect of payments, from web3 to web2, to telegram & twitter combined.

Now that the infrastructure is there, it's time to bet on the things that matter and actually have potential within the app, therefore, expect next update to be a cleanup of features/revamp of existing ones.
